name: Line speed
description: Tests your internet download speed once a night, outside download hours, and keeps a week of results.
author: TheMightyTRexUK

settings.label: Test at
settings.hint: Choose an hour when nothing is downloading.

settings.label: Test size
settings.hint: Larger is more accurate on fast lines, and uses more of any data allowance.

actions.label: Test now
actions.confirm: Downloads a test file now. Continue?

changed: **Shared helper:** the helper every example shares sends Jellyfin's key the way Jellyfin 12 asks for it. This plug-in does not ask Jellyfin anything, so it works as before.
**Lighter at rest:** it wakes about once a minute while nothing asks it anything, not twice a second, and writes nothing to its folder when a run goes well.
**Starts faster:** its image comes with Python's modules already compiled, so a start takes about a quarter of the processor time.

added: **A logo** in Settings, Plug-ins, in the Catalogue and on its dashboard cards.
**Its cards say how things are:** a status and when they last changed, in the grey band at the top of each card.
**Updates safely:** before an update it finishes what it is doing and starts nothing new.
changed: Needs Starboard with plug-in API 1.14 or later. A Starboard with an older plug-in API keeps version 1.0.0.

added: Tests your internet download speed once a night, outside download hours, and keeps a week of results.
